original_hook: 📰 CoinDesk reports stablecoin wallets are increasingly displacing traditional bank accounts as consumer payment hubs. Source: Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub While that sounds like an immediate win for crypto adoption, it explains why $BTC remains compressed around $77,374. When new capital enters dollar-pegged rails for yield and daily payments, holding times increase in fiat substitutes rather than rotating straight into spot Bitcoin. Expanded on-chain liquidity is acting as a short-term buffer, locking capital in payment infrastructure until an explicit macro trigger hits. The flip side. If wallet platforms deploy automated DEX conversion or auto-invest tools, that sidelined dollar float can rapidly turn into spot buy pressure Which level confirms your setup on $BTC?
